observation_limits: Debugger first guard identity line measures direct invocation; test-only argument Proxy observes subsequent reachable JS mutations. Probe attachment is excluded. Port-draft writes separately recorded. Precise coverage measures maintenance/reconcile. Net state snapshots are not transient traces. No SQL/provider locks or real COMMIT proof.

encoding.state_refs: Each state_refs field maps an original case state field name to state_pool SHA256. Restore it and shared_case_fields to expand the original JSON record.
encoding.hash_input: UTF-8 JSON with compact separators, ensure_ascii=false, original object key insertion order; SHA256. BigInt markers remain objects with $bigint string.
encoding.preserved: All JSON values and state map insertion orders. This is not byte-for-byte raw JSON whitespace preservation.
encoding.roundtrip_assertion: All 91 expanded records equal original records; every state serializes with identical insertion order.
